name: Ink and Intention - Interactive Workshop by Project Khwaab
description:
Ink and Intention is a workshop that teaches you the art of Alignment and Manifestation. Learn how to gently release your limiting beliefs, step into your abundant self-worth, and truly create your own reality- all through immersive guided journalling prompts. Walk in with one opportunity area for the evening. This creative, expressive workshop teaches you how to manifest harmony in any area of life.
The workshop guides the participant to align their heart, mind, and energy to their dreams and step into fulfilled dreams. You will learn how to write out inner narratives that don't just describe your future, but phenomenally create it. Learn to manifest- literally ANY KHWAAB <3
Theme: Alignment and Manifestation
At the heart of this workshop is releasing your limiting beliefs, tapping into your true self-worth, and creating a life of fulfilled dreams- the essence of Project Khwaab.
Come as you are, and leave with tools and wisdom that are truly the answer to creating a life full of love, joy, harmony, and aligned dreams from the magic of your mind and journal.
A glimpse of how my journey unfolded phenomenally after practicing these very tools that I am about to teach; it is a portal to absolute magic.

name: Qu for Quiz - Quiz
description: Its Friday and its QuforQuiz. So say tata to office and be at Atta Galatta.

name: Live Drawing Bootcamp  - Art Workshop
description:
Live Drawing Bootcamp: Learn how to draw on location and maintain a sketchbook with this 4-part live drawing bootcamp! Each session will begin with an instructional segment, learning an aspect of life drawing and building skills, followed by a live location demo and a practice session for participants. Instructional sessions will be conducted at Atta Galatta, Indiranagar, followed by the demo and drawing session at a different location in the area each week. 
Each week we tackle something different - 
Session 1: Drawing Nature and Organic shapes. 
Session 2: Understanding Perspective and architecture. 
Session 3: Drawing people. 
Session 4: Capturing Light and Colour. 
Dates: Sundays 9 AM-12 PM (3hrs) on 16th Aug, 23rd Aug, 30th Aug & 6th September.
Facilitated by Jyotsna Ramesh (Animator & Illustrator), Instagram: @jojorambles
PLEASE NOTE: the workshop will have 4 sessions conducted on 4 different days, and the price is inclusive of all 4 sessions.

name: Tiny Budget Big Story - Workshop
description:
First Brick Collective is hosting a practical workshop with Pranab Ganguly, Creative Director with 18+ years leading campaigns for Amazon, Adobe, and Intel, on building high-impact brand stories without a big agency budget. He will be breaking down his working framework for what to kill, keep, and steal so you can make sharper creative decisions using real-world case studies like Zomato, Fevicol, and Dollar Shave Club. 
Actionable strategies that save you money and leave you with one concrete decision for your business that same week. 
Limited seats.

name: Martbaan  - Poetry Afternoon
description: Martbaan brings together some of the most youngest and consistently loved voices from Bangalore's grassroots poetry communities specific to Hindi & Urdu (Ghazal, Nazm, Geet, Kavita). Over months of open mics, these poets have been applauded, while many remain undiscovered beyond local circles. Martbaan is an attempt to give them a bigger stage they deserve and offer the audience a very entertaining afternoon of discovering new artists.  // In summary, Martbaan celebrates some of the youngest and best voices in Hindi/Urdu in town, while also hoping to get a larger and newer audience appreciation and discovery by supporters of the scene who curate larger events.

name: Lahe Lahe Caravan presents Harry Potter Book Discussion - Book Talk and Discussion
description:
For hard-core Potterheads age 12 and above!
Get into the minds of the characters, ferret out the intricacies of the plot - enter the wizarding world and share your thoughts and insights!
Will help if you have read all the Harry Potter books - this discussion will be based only on the books and not the movies.
The event is curated by Lahe Lahe Caravan and is being hosted at Atta Galatta.

name: Atta Galatta presents “Support Group” - Support Group
description:
People make up big cities, but what makes up people’s lives, hopefully not loneliness. Loneliness is an intensely painful state that arises out of a lack of intimacy and connectedness. People from every walk of life, even those with social contacts or pursuing successful careers, can experience sadness from the absence of belonging. This painful experience is felt in a myriad of contexts, such as breakups, disagreeing families, fear of rejection, unrelatability, shyness, and so on
This support group has been constituted to bring people struggling with disconnectedness in various contexts together for a shared experience of comfort, belonging, laughter, guidance, and above all, to break the cycle of sustained loneliness
The support is being organized and moderated by Nimesh George and Gokul R, who are practicing psychologists based in Bangalore

name: DOWN THE RABBIT HOLE — LIVE AT ATTA GALATTA - A RabbittHoles Quiz Night
description:
Mythology, sports, business, Bollywood, pop culture — if it's part of growing up Indian, it's fair game tonight.
Through the evening, we'll be unravelling a RabbittHole tale about India together — story by story, guess by guess. Some rounds will hand you facts you never knew. Others will take things you thought you already knew and flip them on their head. Either way, we make you guess before we explain, and the reveals are where all the fun lives.
🗓️ 16th August · 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM
📍 Atta Galatta
🎟️ ₹399 per ticket
👥 All ages welcome
What's included with your ticket:

Entry to the full live quiz — rounds of trivia and stories woven into one evening-long RabbittHole
A seat on a team (solo? we'll pair you up with fellow curious minds)
All the twists, spin-the-wheel surprises, and reveals we've built for this one

Food and drinks will be available at Atta Galatta through the evening (not included in your ticket; order as you like).
Come with your team, come solo, come just curious. Either way, you'll leave knowing things you didn't expect to know.

name: HEARTBeat Unscripted 6: Desi Tadka 🌶️✨ - 100% Improv. 100% Unscripted. 100% Desi.
description:
Celebrate the Independence Day long weekend with an evening of heartwarming, spontaneous theatre! HEARTBeat Unscripted returns for its 6th edition with a special theme celebrating all things Indian: Desi Tadka.
Stepping on stage without a script, our performers bring high-energy playfulness, rich Indian characters, relatable everyday stories, and nostalgic tropes to life - entirely inspired by your live suggestions. From hilarious household moments to immersive scenes with visual projections, it’s an interactive, joyful experience created in real-time right before your eyes.
We are kicking off at the Auspicious Improv Muhurtam of 6:13 PM (yes, our astrologer picked the exact minute for maximum laughter 😉).
Bring your friends, celebrate the weekend, and immerse yourself in a night of local flavor and unscripted fun!
 * 📅 Date: Sunday, August 16th
 * ⏰ Time: 6:13 PM (Auspicious Improv Muhurtam 😉)
 * 📍 Venue: Atta Galatta, Indiranagar, Bengaluru
 * 🎭 Age Limit: 16+

name: A Woman Healed Is A Force Unleashed - Pranic Healing Session
description:
Join us at Atta Galatta on August 21st, 6-7 PM to explore how Pranic Healing helps you easily restore health and harmony in your life.
Get to know how simply and properly you can,

Restore Health & Vitality
Develop Emotional Strength & Mental Clarity

name: Food In Literature - Book Club
description:
Food is never just about what’s on the plate- it is memory, identity, migration, and culture served together. This month, we savour A Matter of Taste: The Penguin Book of Indian Writing on Food, edited by Nilanjana S. Roy, an anthology that brings together essays, memoirs, fiction, and poetry celebrating India’s rich culinary imagination. What stories do our kitchens preserve, and how do the flavours we inherit shape who we are?
Book of the month: A Matter of Taste: The Penguin Book of Indian Writing on Food. Edited by Nilanjana S. Roy
When: Saturday, 22nd August, 2026 at 11 a.m.
Where: Atta Galatta Bookstore, Indira Nagar
Ages: 18+
Hosted by: Prachi Grover
Registration is mandatory as we have limited spots.
The session is free & copies of the book are available at the store. 
Prachi Grover is a culinary consultant and educator and is the founder of “From Words to Wok”; a community for people who love to read and eat.

name: AG Lit Sisters Presents: India- Many Voices, One Nation - Book Club
description:
As India celebrates another year of independence, AG Lit Sisters invites readers to explore the many voices that make up our nation's story.
This month, we'll read books by and about Dalit, Bahujan, Adivasi, farmer, student, queer, disabled, and other historically marginalised communities. Through fiction, memoirs, essays, and autobiographies, we'll discuss identity, resilience, resistance, hope, and the pursuit of dignity and justice, while reflecting on what it means to celebrate independence through diverse literary perspectives.
Join us for an afternoon of thoughtful conversations, respectful dialogue, and books that remind us that one nation is made richer by many voices.

name: Mastering Mutual Funds - Learn What NOT to Do When Building a Winning Portfolio
description:
Investing in mutual funds is one of the most effective ways to grow your wealth, but costly mistakes, hidden fees, and mismatched portfolios often drain potential returns. Whether you’re a beginner looking to start right or an investor wanting to optimize your existing portfolio, this hands-on workshop provides the clarity and strategy you need.
In this interactive session, you’ll demystify how mutual funds work without the confusing financial jargon. You’ll learn how to identify common investment pitfalls, cut unnecessary costs, and match your unique life goals with the right types of funds.
More than just theory, this workshop is designed for immediate action. You will map out your personalized investment roadmap live during the session, giving you a clear, actionable plan tailored to your financial targets.
Stop guessing with your hard-earned money and start investing with confidence. Reserve your spot today to master your portfolio and take full control of your financial future.

name: Mastering Connection: A 5-Part Emotional Intelligence Series - Emotional Intelligence Workshop
description:
Elevate your relationships, communication, and conflict resolution! Join our transformative 5-part series designed to help you navigate personal and professional dynamics using the core pillars of Emotional Intelligence (EQ).
Across five actionable sessions, we will dive into:
* Self-Awareness: Recognizing your emotional triggers.
* Self-Regulation: Responding thoughtfully under pressure.
* Motivation: Driving meaningful connection.
* Empathy: Truly understanding other perspectives.
* Social Skills: Building trust and navigating tough conversations.
Transform how you connect with others and lead with empathy. Register today to secure your spot

name: Self-Awareness: Decoding Your Triggers - Emotional intelligence Workshop
description:
Unlock the foundation of emotional intelligence and transform how you interact with others.
Before you can build healthier relationships, you need to understand the internal drivers that guide your reactions. In this introductory session, you'll learn how to tune into your emotional landscape, identify your hidden triggers, and recognize how your moods directly influence your communication style.
* What You’ll Learn: Techniques for self-reflection, recognizing body signals before an emotional spike, and accurately labeling your feelings in real time.
* Key Takeaway: The power to pause between a stimulus and your response.

name: The Night of the Hunter - Film Screening
description: In Depression-era West Virginia, a preacher marries a widow, Willa, with his eyes on the treasure looted by her late husband. But when Willa refuses to divulge any information, the preacher has to go on a hunt for Willa's two young children, who hold the key to the treasure.

name: Curious Minds Trivia Night  - Trivia Night
description:
Forget everything you think a trivia night is. 
Curious Minds Trivia Night is an interactive, people-first experience that blends pop culture, teamwork, strategy, and friendly competition into one memorable evening. Before the event, participants fill out a short registration form sharing their favourite movies, TV shows, music, and interests. Parts of the trivia are then built around those responses, making every edition unique and tailored to the people in the room. Expect a mix of visual rounds, quote challenges, picture rounds, strategic betting rounds, and a few surprises along the way. Some rounds will test your memory, others your observation, and a few will reward teamwork, creativity, and quick thinking.
Whether you’re a seasoned trivia enthusiast or someone looking for a genuinely good evening with strangers — this event is designed to bring people together through laughter, conversation, and a little healthy rivalry.
Come with a team or walk in solo — we’ll find you one. All you need is curiosity and a willingness to play.
Come once. Come back forever

name: TechnoCats - Film Screening
description:
A search for purpose in the fiercely competitive world of the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT).
SYNOPSIS 
Seven young people from seven parts of the country (the Seven Samurai) dream of joining the IIT. Competing against one million applicants, they gain admission, but are soon disillusioned. Will they make their presence felt on the world stage? Or burn out along the way? The filmmaker, an IIT alumnus, follows the Seven Samurai over seven years—from their first semester to the third year of their careers. Interwoven with their journey are four of the filmmaker’s classmates from 35 years ago, including one who made an audiovisual on IIT student life. As he rediscovers old slides and struggles to sync them with the audio track, this forgotten past frames the film’s exploration of winning at all cost. 
DIRECTOR’S STATEMENT 
I enrolled for a B.Tech. in electrical engineering at IIT Delhi, but was dejected at the barrage of tests and emphasis on grades over all else. Where was the time to learn, ponder, speculate? 35 years later, I was surprised to meet students from very different backgrounds who felt similarly. I decided to revisit my past and connect with some of my classmates. Their stories are interwoven with  those of the seven students at the heart of this film, to create a conversation across generations.

name: The Landscape Within - Mindful drawing workshop
description:
Our inner world is shaped by thoughts, emotions, memories, challenges and moments of quiet joy. Yet many of these experiences are difficult to put into words.
The Landscape Within is a mindful drawing experience that invites you to explore these unseen landscapes through pen, paper and patterns. Through guided practices, we will move through observation, reflection and flow to create artwork that doesn't aim to represent what we see but what we carry.
Whether you're picking up a pen for the first time or have been drawing for years, this workshop offers a space where curiosity matters far more than skill. 
What You'll Leave With

Three personal artworks inspired by your inner landscape
Simple mindful drawing techniques you can continue at home
A creative practice for reflection and self-expression
A fresh perspective on slowing down with intention

name: Lino Print Workshop - Art Workshop
description:
This hands-on workshop introduces the basics of lino cut printmaking, from carving a simple design to inking and printing your own artwork. Participants will be guided through the process step by step and will leave with their own prints, perfect as small artworks or gifts.
The session runs for three hours and includes demonstrations, supported making time, and space to experiment.
Open to beginners and anyone curious about printmaking — no prior experience needed. Suitable for ages 14+.

What should I bring?
Clothes you don’t mind getting messy in, ideas or finished sketches for designs (found images from books are welcome), and lots of creativity.

What’s provided?
All printing tools, paper, and inks will be provided.

What do I take home?
All finished artworks are yours to keep, along with any unfinished pieces. Participants will also keep their carved lino block, allowing them to reprint at home with basic supplies

name: Formula for Crime - Book signing
description:
Formula for Crime is a gripping investigative thriller that takes readers deep into the world of criminal profiling, forensic science, and the psychology behind crime. Blending suspense with authentic investigative detail, the novel follows a compelling mystery where every clue matters, keeping readers guessing until the very end. Perfect for fans of intelligent, fast-paced crime fiction.
Join us at Atta Galatta for the book signing of “Formula for Crime”.

name: Ocean Explorers - Activity  morning for kids
description:
Join Fleetfoot Scuba & Atta Galatta for a fun, hands-on ocean adventure designed for curious young minds!
📅 30th August
⏰ 11:00 AM – 1:30 PM
👧 Ages 8–14 years
🎟️ ₹600 per child

name: Book Launch & Interactive Author Session: Rub.AI - Book Talk and Discussion
description:
What happens when Artificial Intelligence becomes more than a machine? What happens when humanity itself is at stake?
Join author Rubai Banerjee for an immersive and interactive launch of her tech fiction novel, Rub.AI - a story that explores the delicate intersection of technology, emotion, and what it truly means to be human.
This is not a conventional book launch. Instead, audiences will embark on a thought-provoking journey through storytelling, games, and conversations about AI and the future of humanity.
What to expect:
· Humans vs AI – A fun interactive game to test whether you can tell human creativity apart from AI-generated content.
· Step into the world of Rub.AI through cinematic visuals, character introductions, and a dramatic reading from one of the novel’s most pivotal scenes.
· Interactive audience participation, where you’ll imagine what life might be like with an AI companion and explore the choices that define our humanity.
· A candid conversation with the author about writing fiction in the age of AI, balancing a corporate career with authorship, and the inspiration behind Rub.AI.
· Book signing and meet-and-greet during the final 10–15 minutes, with an opportunity to interact personally with the author and get your copy signed.
Whether you’re a reader, a technology enthusiast, a writer, or simply curious about the future, this event promises an engaging hour of stories, ideas, and conversations that extend well beyond the pages of a book.
Come prepared not just to hear a story, but to become part of it.

name: Eat, Sip & Paint - ToteBag Edition - Art Workshop
description:
Unwind with a relaxed morning of creativity, good food, and great company at Eat, Sip & Paint – ToteBag Edition by Fitaraa.
Design and paint your very own Fitaraa yoga mat tote bag while enjoying delicious snacks and beverages in the cozy atmosphere of Atta Galatta. Whether you're an experienced artist or have never picked up a paintbrush before, this beginner-friendly experience is all about having fun, expressing yourself, and taking home something you've created.
What's Included

All art supplies and painting materials
Snacks and beverages during the session
Surprise goodie bag
A guided, beginner-friendly painting experience

Everyone is welcome. No prior painting experience is needed—just bring yourself and enjoy a creative, relaxing afternoon.
Leave with a one-of-a-kind hand-painted Fitaraa tote bag, new memories, and a fun creative experience shared with fellow art lovers.

name: The Unheard Line - Hindi and Urdu Poetry Workshop
description:
We hum these lines. We are moved by them. And yet, for the most part, we hear only their surface – the melody, the ache, the obvious sense of the words. Underneath sits a second poem, and often a third: a borrowed image, a buried argument, a reply to someone who wrote a hundred years earlier.
The Unheard Line is an invitation to hear that lower register. It is not a lecture on prosody, and it asks for no prior training. It is closer to a guided learning – the kind where a familiar song is played, paused, and opened, until the room realises it has been living inside a meaning it never quite saw.
Urdu is the spine of the session, with room for the progressive Hindi poets, the other tongues of India, and modern world poetry. Ghalib, Mir, Momin, Hasrat Mohani, Faiz, Firaq, Dushyant Kumar, Nida Fazli, Gulzar, Kaifi Azmi, and other poets. Join us for a guided workshop for the appreciation of poetry. 
About the host: Samartha Vashishtha is a bilingual poet, writer, and translator, the author of four published volumes across Hindi and English, and the third generation of a family of poets.

name: An Evening with Dr. Gowher Yusuf - Poetry Meetup
description:
Join us for an intimate literary evening with Dr. Gowher Yusuf, author of Unspoken Words a heartfelt collection of poetry that gives voice to emotions we often struggle to express.
Through an engaging conversation, Dr. Gowher Yusuf will share her writing journey, the inspiration behind her poems, and how poetry can become a space for healing, reflection, and hope. The session will include readings from Unspoken Words, audience interaction, and a Q&A, followed by a book signing.
Whether you are a poetry lover, an aspiring writer, or someone seeking stories that resonate with the heart, this promises to be an evening of meaningful conversations and shared emotions.

name: What Writing Means to Me  - Writing Workshop
description:
Have you ever wanted to write but didn't know where to begin? Or perhaps you've been writing for years and are looking for fresh inspiration? Join us for an engaging evening that explores writing as a tool for creativity, reflection, and self-expression.
Hosted by Dr. Saurish Hegde (Educator & Writer), this interactive workshop will include a short talk, guided creative writing exercises, open discussions, and an opportunity to connect with fellow readers and writers.
📅 Date: 5 September
🕠 Time: 5:30 PM – 7:00 PM
Highlights:
✨ Free entry
✨ Limited to 30 participants
✨ No prior writing experience required
✨ Interactive writing session and discussion
✨ Meet fellow writers and book lovers
Seats are limited—register early and join us for an evening dedicated to discovering what writing means to you.

name: An Evening with Namratha Stanley - book launch, meet and greet
description:
Join internationally published author Namratha Stanley for an intimate evening celebrating Vineyard Melody—a memoir of resilience, reinvention, and the unexpected path that led her from India to the most bucolic vineyards of France.
Our moderator, Deepa Rao Acharya, has donned various hats- as a Times of India journalist, TV and Bollywood scriptwriter, short story writer, and content creator. Her event company Lit Spirit is tied up with her Foundation, which aims at bringing about social transformation through spiritual awareness. 
In conversation with Deepa Rao, Namratha will discuss her journey from surviving domestic abuse to building a life in France as an entrepreneur, educator, and wine professional. The evening will explore the making of her memoir, its publication in the United States, and its journey toward screen adaptation.
The programme includes a live conversation, audience Q&A, meet-and-greet, refreshments, and a book-signing session.
Date: Saturday, 5 September
Time: 6:00 PM – 8:30 PM
Event Pass: ₹350 (includes refreshments)
Books will be available for purchase and signing at the venue.

name: The Next Curve Within - A Quarterly Flagship Experience by The Next Curve
description:
Some of life’s most meaningful transformations don’t begin around us—they begin within us.
The Next Curve Within is the flagship quarterly gathering by The Next Curve, bringing together inspiring voices from leadership, health, longevity, mindfulness and sustainability to help us prepare for the most important years of our lives.
This is not another seminar. It is an immersive afternoon of ideas, lived experiences and authentic conversations designed for those who believe that growing older should mean growing stronger, healthier, wiser and more purposeful.
This edition explores five dimensions of transformation:

Finding clarity through meditation and mindful living.
Building a regenerative future through water and conscious action.
Reinventing life after 75 with purpose and vitality.
Preventing disease by embracing a healthier way of life.
Understanding how healthy, resilient leaders build high-performing organisations through physical, mental and emotional transformation.

Whether you are an entrepreneur, corporate leader, professional, educator, healthcare practitioner, student or someone committed to lifelong growth, Within offers insights that go beyond knowledge and inspire meaningful action.
Event Details
Date: Saturday, 19th September 2026
Time: 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM
Venue: Atta Galatta, Bengaluru
Access Pass: ₹300 per person
Featured Speakers

Cherian Kuruvila – The Quiet Revolution
Vivek Srinivasan – Every Drop Matters
Hari Bhaskaran – Life Begins at 75
Dr. Dharini – Prevention Before Prescription
Keynote: Salma Moosa – Drive to Thrive: Building Fit & Healthy Leaders to Build Fast-Growing Organisations

The evening concludes with Conversations That Matter—a guided networking experience where meaningful connections are built through thoughtful dialogue rather than business card exchanges.
The Next Curve Within is for those ready to reinvent ageing, regenerate the planet and redesign themselves—one conversation at a time.
